name: French Advance — Tactics
description: Tactical ideas in the French Advance Variation.

drills.name: Undermining the Chain
drills.description: Black to move. Find the thematic break and develop the queen to pressure the center.
drills.briefExplanation: cxd4 undermines the center, while Qb6 and Nge7 pile up pressure on d4 and prepare further development.
